components.label: Knock Sensor Module
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Detects door vibrations and triggers the Arduino interrupt.

components.label: Arduino UNO
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Validates the knock pattern and commands the motor driver.

components.label: Battery Pack
components.voltage: ≈ 6V (4× AA series) — diagram simplified to 2 cells visible
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Supplies motor driver and Arduino with power.

components.label: Motor Driver
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Switches battery current to drive the motor in either direction.

components.label: DC Motor (Vertical Mount)
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Converts electrical power into rotational torque.

components.label: Vertical Motor Shaft
components.axis: Y (vertical) — shared with motor and gear
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Transfers motor rotation to the main gear; orange marker stripe shows angle.

components.label: Main Gear
components.fixed_or_moving: rotates about Y, same axis as shaft
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Converts shaft rotation into linear rack motion.

components.label: Rack Gear
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Couples gear rotation to the bolt's linear motion.

components.label: Rack Teeth (Trapezoidal)
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Visible mesh element — clarifies how gear rotation drives linear bolt motion.

components.label: Gear/Rack Contact Highlight
components.fixed_or_moving: fixed in world space (does not translate with rack)
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Soft yellow pulse at the engagement point during motion.

components.label: Sliding Bolt
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Seats into / retracts from strike plate.

components.label: MacBook Microphone (optional input)
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Optional. Captures real-world knocks/taps/claps near the laptop and feeds them into the unlock sequence.

components.label: Mic Knock Detector
components.role_in_unlock_sequence: Optional. RMS spike detector with sensitivity slider, baseline tracking, and 1.5s cooldown.
